captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a heavy-duty parametric tent spike designed for secure anchoring. It features a long, T-shaped main body consisting of a wide flat base and a perpendicular reinforcing spine that runs along its length. The bottom of the spike is tapered to a sharp wedge point to ease ground insertion. Near the top, the spine features a functional cutout design consisting of a circular rope hole, a slanted square notch for securing guy lines, and a second half-circular guide at the bottom of the notch. A flat, rectangular hammer pad caps the very top of the spike, providing a solid surface for driving it into the ground.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric tent spike in OpenSCAD with a customizable depth, base width, and spine thickness. The model should feature a T-shaped cross-section, a pointed tip at the bottom, a flat hammer pad on top, and a rope attachment system near the top including a circular hole and a slanted notch.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using a main 'spike' module that combines a base cube and a centered spine cube to form a T-shaped profile. A series of nested 'difference' operations are used to bevel the tip using rotated cubes, drill a horizontal cylinder for the rope hole, and subtract a rotated cube and a cylinder to form the slanted securing notch. Finally, a flat hammer pad cube is added at the top of the spike using a union operation.
